verdict.rationale: The firm's own executive compensation page says it designs equity instruments, including incentive and non-statutory stock options, RSUs, SARs and phantom stock, with vesting and acceleration features. That covers the core option-plan part of the story. Nothing in the pack covers country-specific schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs, and the firm's listed offices do not include the UK, Germany or India. Missing for 10: documented UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP design; independent corroboration of equity plan design work.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: We design equity instruments (restricted stock, incentive and non-statutory stock options, RSUs, SARs, phantom stock and more) with design features, vesting schedules, acceleration triggers, contractual restrictions and other features to align employees' and employers' incentive and retention goals
